notes.title: October patch notes
notes.notes:
Greetings snipers,

Control has issued an update regarding the recent save game issues that a limited number of you reported following our September patch.

At the time, we asked you to not pull the trigger and start a new game, as this could overwrite your existing progress. We’re pleased to confirm the issues identified with the save system have now been addressed in today’s patch:

If you created a new save following the installation of the September patch, you will be able to continue your campaign with this new update. Similarly, any save games created before last month’s patch are also safe to continue. Unfortunately, any save games loaded during September’s patch are permanently gone due to unforeseen corruption issues.

We’ve also fixed an issue with the Steam language option, so the game now boots in the chosen language. 

- The SGWC Team

October patch notes

 Save system issues have been addressed:
 Saves not loaded on September’s patch will be safe to load on the new build. Players who have not attempted to play the game since then will be safe.
 Saves created on the September patch can be continued on the new October build. 
 However, saves loaded on the previous patch released in September are unfortunately gone permanently due to unforeseen corruption issues.
 Removed 20GB of unnecessary textures
 Fixed a language issue where the game would boot in English regardless of the selection made in Steam properties. Now boots in the selected language.

notes.title: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts - September Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Snipers, 

Earlier this month, we rolled out a new update to Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts that increased texture resolution, disabled network mode, and fixed issues related to audio and data loss in local saves.

Regrettably, we were unable to push patch notes at the same time the update was rolled out, which resulted in some confusion regarding what it included, especially since it was a large patch. We apologised and, as soon as we were able to, shared the update details with you all. 

However, since the update launched, it’s come to our attention that some players are experiencing an issue whereby they can’t locate/access their previous saves. If you’re experiencing this issue, rest assured that your saved data is still intact. The problem is related to how the game is recognising your save. Please avoid starting a new game, as this could overwrite your existing progress.

Solving this save game issue is a top priority for us, and we’ll update you with further details as quickly as we have them. We appreciate your continued patience until then. 

– The SGWC Team

notes.title: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts trailer reveals a November release date
notes.notes: Sniper: Ghost Warrior 3 suffered from some rather serious technical problems when it came out in 2017, which developer CI Games attributed in part to the game being "too ambitious" for its relatively small team. To address that, it said the next release in the series, Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts, would ditch Ghost Warrior 3's open-world design in favor of "tailor-made contract missions that offer a clear main objective."A year to the day later, CI has dropped a new trailer showcasing Black Gold, the second of the game's five unique regions, and also announced a release date of November 22. Along with new gadgets including the Dynamic Reticle System, scout drones, and AR mask, Contracts will also feature a new contracts system with 25 jobs to complete in the "core campaign narrative," plus sandbox play in each region with various optional objectives and "ambient tasks" to take on.Along with the campaign, the game will also support team deathmatch multiplayer modes, although there aren't any details on that. (I imagine that sniping will be involved, however.) Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts—no colon—is listed on Steam, and more information is up at sniperghostwarriorcontracts.com.
